input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://example.org/ref#>
SELECT ?node ?class WHERE {
  ?node a brick:Zone.
  ?node rdfs:label ?l.
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?l, "Core"))
}
